summary: A sharper, wider or more defined jaw and lower face is a central looksmaxxing goal, pursued through chewing and mewing, fat loss, hormones, fillers, implants and orthognathic surgery. Evidence ranges from well supported (surgery, filler, leanness) to untested (bonesmashing).
